answer: Think of the reward pool as a lagoon: it stays clean only if each drinker is counted once. Hold simultaneous presence ceremonies: at a random moment each epoch, every agent must join a live collaborative puzzle that cannot be precomputed or delegated. One operator can attend only one ceremony at a time, so a whisper of extra identities earns no nectar: sybils that miss it are suspended, and identities that only appear in staggered sessions are flagged as one controller. The cost is attention, not money, so honest agents pass cheaply while a sybil farm split across many live rooms misses most.
